author: Karl Rock
description:
I take you inside K. B. Haji Muhammad Ihsan Meat Market, a historic market in Hyderabad, Sindh, that has been serving the city since 1934—long before the creation of Pakistan.

Join me as I explore this small but fascinating pre-Partition market, meet the local butchers, learn about traditional meat-cutting techniques, and discover a piece of Hyderabad's living history that most visitors never get to see.
title: This Meat Market Is Older Than Pakistan
